2608.23552.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
2608.23552.paper_summary: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
2608.23552.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型是順序處理器，但長期代理需要超越模型權重和主動上下文的外部資訊和計算。Prime Agent 是一個開源的長期評估和編碼代理工作流程的工具。持久的 IPython REPL 遵循遞歸語言模型的抽象，用於程式上下文處理和測試時計算，而持續工具則在不同軌跡中保留歷史、記憶、技能、提示和子代理規範。遞歸子代理通過直接的代理對代理通信進行協調，而代理視圖讓人類檢查和管理由守護進程支持的會話。Prime Agent 標準化執行、恢復、驗證和資源核算，同時將策略構建留給模型。這種低摩擦、表達力強的膜防止了工具故障變成模型故障，並推動測量朝向模型真正的最大潛在能力。Prime Agent 將 ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 從 30% 提升至 95.5%，並在長上下文編碼、GPU 核心生成、模擬器構建和自主 nanoGPT 速通中匹配或超越原生和流行的工具。在 Factorio 中，我們發現精煉允許持續的技術進步，而專用子代理則使平行工作成為可能。代碼可在 https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent 獲得。
